title: Connected irregular cospectral graphs with distinct Lovász numbers
summary: For every integer $n \geq 11$, we construct connected, irregular, nonisomorphic graphs on $n$ vertices with equal adjacency, Laplacian, signless Laplacian, normalized Laplacian, and Seidel spectra and equal independence, clique, chromatic, complement chromatic, and maximum-cut numbers, but distinct Lovász $\vartheta$-numbers. We join each graph in a fixed cospectral, nonisomorphic regular pair on ten vertices, due to van Dam and Haemers (2003), with $K_{n-10}$.
